title: Proton energy and charge radius from complete colour-channel support
description:
Read the full paper (PDF)

The colour-three proton fixes the exact energy share 8 alpha squared and the distinct radius coefficient 4(1 − alpha/10).

Maria Smith derives eight non-return mediator channels for energy, six colour/Fold paths for the radial edge, and nine internal colour-pair cells plus one external charge for the complete radius support. The full terminal electromagnetic construction supplies alpha without fitted proton or probe parameters.

After prediction sealing, the registered proton rest energy gives approximately 399.714076823 keV, inside the complete Parker spectral-analysis range. The registered reduced proton Compton carrier gives approximately 0.840621760898 fm; its full propagated interval lies inside all four registered current radius comparisons.

This edition supplies the electromagnetic return/boundary/tower forcing argument and the complete candidate-membership and uniqueness proofs. The paper includes full intermediate mathematics, explicit MeV-to-keV and dimensionless-to-femtometre conversions, every energy and radius alternative, all current and historical observations, source context, complete 3,072- and 2,304-form grammars and native Lean verification. The archive contains pinned V3/V4 source, build and zero-axiom audit evidence, complete program and empirical comparisons, and portable exact-arithmetic reproduction.

Scientific author: Maria Smith, Ernos Labs. V3 physics: 10.5281/zenodo.21761655. V3 monograph: 10.5281/zenodo.21900790. V4 edition 0.4: 10.5281/zenodo.24320778.
